title: Solid State Physics II
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the dipole moment p per unit volume, averaged over the volume of a cell."
The polarization P is defined as the dipole moment p per unit volume, averaged over the volume of a cell.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the energy in a ferromagnetic crystal which directs the magnetization along certain crystallographic axes called directions of easy magnetization."
Anisotropy energy is the energy in a ferromagnetic crystal which directs the magnetization along certain crystallographic axes called directions of easy magnetization.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the time interval characterizing the restoration of a disturbed system to its equilibrium configuration; the relaxation frequency is defined as the reciprocal of the relaxation time."

Dipole relaxation time is the time interval characterizing the restoration of a disturbed system to its equilibrium configuration; the relaxation frequency is defined as the reciprocal of the relaxation time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a consequence of anisotropy energy density."
The anisotropy field is a consequence of anisotropy energy density.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of crystalline solids, through methods such as quantum mechanics, crystallography, electromagnetism, and metallurgy."
Solid-state physics is the study of crystalline solids, through methods such as quantum mechanics, crystallography, electromagnetism, and metallurgy.
fib: ______ is the area of mismatch between volumes of material that have a common orientation of the crystallographic axes.
A grain boundary is the area of mismatch between volumes of material that have a common orientation of the crystallographic axes.
______ is defined as the spontaneous magnetic moment per unit volume.
The saturation magnetization Ms is defined as the spontaneous magnetic moment per unit volume.
______ is a lattice distortion created about a line formed by the solidification process, plastic deformation, vacancy condensation or atomic mismatch in solid solutions.
A line defect is a lattice distortion created about a line formed by the solidification process, plastic deformation, vacancy condensation or atomic mismatch in solid solutions.
______ is a planar imperfection, with electron, phonon, and magnon surface states.
The crystal surface is a planar imperfection, with electron, phonon, and magnon surface states.
______ is a lattice irregularity having one or more of its dimensions on the order of an atomic dimension.
A crystalline defect is a lattice irregularity having one or more of its dimensions on the order of an atomic dimension.
